transcript.text: what is cicd cicd is a process to
automate the building testing and
deploying of applications every time you
make a code change so that you can
update and deliver your applications
faster let's understand this more
clearly with a diagram whenever a
developer makes some changes and pushes
it to get repository like GitHub an
automated CI server like genkins will
continuously monitor this repository for
any new code changes and if they
detected it triggers the pipeline which
automatically builds and tests the code
every time you make a change this
process of automatically building and
testing the codee is known as continuous
integration once the code is built and
test it is then ready for the next part
which is the deployment part you can
deploy your applications either on
kubernetes or on servers and this
complete process is known as cicd
pipeline for more information on
Hands-On cicd projects check out the
videos on my channel
